content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know how I can compare two analog values on the same input by storing a value at a certain time and comparing it to another value obtained five seconds later? If the second value is higher, perform one action; if it is lower, perform another. Any help would be greatly appreciated. Thank you.

[product_name] includes a built-in feature called 'Analog Watchdog' that is designed for this purpose. You can use a timer to control the enable input for this feature, or connect an external trigger using a digital input to synchronize the measurement process by linking it to the enable input.
Thank you for the quick response. How can I distinguish between the value increasing or decreasing and set different actions based on that?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to compare analog values captured at different times in a [company_name] controller, looking for a way to execute different actions based on whether the value has increased or decreased. The built-in 'Analog Watchdog' feature is suggested as a solution, but users need more detailed guidance on applying conditional actions for changes in value.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the product to provide a straightforward method for comparing analog values over time and to easily configure distinct actions when values increase or decrease.
